date_basis: UTC; local execution spans 5-6 November 2026 Asia/Jakarta
motivation: Test separated host/subdomain/path URL-only views and stricter calibration/false-alarm regression gates after the observed weighted study. All previously scored cohorts, including Zenodo websites V2, are observed regression checks, never new tests or selection data.
base_encoder: Reuse the exact fit-only frozen encoder and ordered feature cache from the previous weighted experiment; keep all source and partition hashes.
new_features: Versioned sanitizer; scheme-free/query-free host char TF-IDF 3-5, subdomain word TF-IDF 1-2, path word TF-IDF 1-2 and 18 numeric structure values. New vocabulary/scaler fit on fitting only. Base fitting cache retains its prior representation; new views use the experiment sanitizer consistently on every partition.
classifier_weights: source_equal_domain_sqrt from previous weighted protocol; fixed across new feature modes, no label changes or test mining
calibration: Source-equal weights on calibration only; sigmoid C=1000, beta calibration using LogisticRegression on log(p), -log(1-p), C=10; both coefficients strictly positive for ranking preservation. Reject nonmonotone calibrators, record failures. Also test beta on the frozen previous research classifier.
threshold: primary empirical 1% per supported source on threshold partition only; secondary pooled 1% frozen before final scoring, descriptive only

selection.priority: detection-eligible first, otherwise calibration-eligible; macro source recall, lower macro Brier, minimum source recall tie-breaks; retain previous research control if none pass; freeze one failed-gate diagnostic challenger before final scoring

new_data: Only publicly licensed raw-URL releases with reconciled label schema/provenance and exposure audit may be admitted. Metadata-only/feature-only/unreconciled releases are recorded as unavailable, never fabricated. Keep the 616050 fitting rows fixed for this feature experiment; additional qualified source data are reserved for locked external testing or a separately predeclared later augmentation experiment.
new_holdout_unavailable: Before training, record the actual source/schema audit and explicit unavailability, then run observed regression checks only; do not reuse Zenodo websites V2 as a new holdout.
human_review: Audit actual blind packs and Indonesia inputs. No automatic label corrections, fabricated reviewers, evidence or Indonesia labels; review queues are development diagnostics, not final gold sampling.
limitations: No Indonesia gold or contemporary temporal holdout established
Every local sidecar, historical registry and current v6 cache remains exposure
Domain separation is not independent campaign validation
Noncommercial research restriction inherited from foundation
